title: Apollos in Ephesus
description: The learned Jew Apollos from Alexandria comes to Ephesus and speaks with burning zeal about Jesus, even though he only knows John's baptism. Priscilla and Aquila take him in and explain the way of God more thoroughly to him. Then he travels to Achaia, where he becomes a great help to the believers and publicly refutes the Jews from the Scriptures by proving that Jesus is the Messiah.
